output.program:
domain(person,[cuddlebug,devin]).
% If Cuddlebug either respects nature or harms nature (but not both), then he is responsible.
axiom(s1, rule([xor(respects_nature(cuddlebug),harms_nature(cuddlebug))], responsible(cuddlebug))).
% Devin visits beaches or enjoys hiking.
axiom(s2, or(visits_beaches(devin),enjoys_hiking(devin))).
% If Devin enjoys hiking, then he either grows up outdoors or appreciates biodiversity, but not both.
axiom(s3, rule([enjoys_hiking(devin)], xor(grows_up_outdoors(devin),appreciates_biodiversity(devin)))).
% For Devin, he either conserves wildlife or harms nature, but not both.
axiom(s4, xor(conserves_wildlife(devin),harms_nature(devin))).
% If Cuddlebug grows up outdoors, then he values the ecosystem and promotes sustainability.
axiom(s5, rule([grows_up_outdoors(cuddlebug)], and(values_ecosystem(cuddlebug),promotes_sustainability(cuddlebug)))).
% For anyone, if they love marine life and promote sustainability, then they conserve wildlife.
axiom(s6, forall(var(x,person), implies(and(loves_marine_life(var(x)),promotes_sustainability(var(x))),conserves_wildlife(var(x))))).
% If Devin either protects habitats or preserves water quality (but not both), then he conserves wildlife.
axiom(s7, rule([xor(protects_habitats(devin),preserves_water_quality(devin))], conserves_wildlife(devin))).
% Devin does not appreciate biodiversity.
axiom(s8, not(appreciates_biodiversity(devin))).
% If Devin grows up outdoors, then he values the ecosystem and promotes sustainability.
axiom(s9, rule([grows_up_outdoors(devin)], and(values_ecosystem(devin),promotes_sustainability(devin)))).
% Devin does not explore caves.
axiom(s10, not(explores_caves(devin))).
% Cuddlebug does not explore caves.
axiom(s11, not(explores_caves(cuddlebug))).
% Devin loves marine life.
axiom(s12, loves_marine_life(devin)).
% Devin collects rocks.
axiom(s13, collects_rocks(devin)).
% If Devin either explores caves or collects rocks (but not both), then he enjoys hiking.
axiom(s14, rule([xor(explores_caves(devin),collects_rocks(devin))], enjoys_hiking(devin))).
